description: List the user's transaction receipts (PDFs, images, structured invoices), newest first. Each entry carries extracted summary fields (merchant, total, date, currency) plus the linked transactionId when attached. Use `transactionHash` (from `get_transactions`) to scope to one transaction, `needsReview=true` to find rows flagged for manual review, and `status` to filter by lifecycle state. Default page 20, max 100.

needsReview.description: If true, only return rows the extractor flagged for manual review.

offset.description: Number of receipts to skip for pagination.

status.description: Filter by lifecycle status. Default: everything except DELETED.

transactionHash.description: Restrict to receipts linked to a single transaction (on-chain hash from get_transactions).

name: list_receipts
